title: smoke test: psp-etl stats
description: Write tests/test_cli_stats.py. The stats command has zero CLI-level tests. Tests must cover: (1) empty DB: all tables render with 'no data' placeholders, exit 0. (2) populated DB: pre-insert images, entries, string_analysis rows, verify vendor counts and generation rows appear in output. (3) --gen filter: only entries for that generation appear in tables. (4) score distribution: with entries that have string_analysis, verify the score distribution table has Min/Mean/P90/Max columns populated. All tests use --data-dir tmp_path.
